identity.title: [v0.91.8][WP-14][unity][tooling] Classify and fix Unity ILPP GetDomainName loop in observatory batch proof

values.summary: Prepare #5332 locally, preserve occupied sidecars, and stop before implementation until ownership is clear.

steps.action: Create the issue-bound FastWork worktree and typed preparation packet
Report #4739/#4741 as occupied and #5107 as read-only readiness unavailable if no native v2 packet exists
Stop before source implementation until the Unity sidecar blocker is cleared

invariants: Occupied worktrees are evidence and must not be reset or overwritten
Preparation records are not implementation authority
Future Unity source edits require fresh ownership checks
Receipts are non-blocking audit evidence only
risks: Unity wrapper paths overlap existing dirty #4739/#4741 work
A stale #5107 branch could be mistaken for execution readiness
Unity ILPP retry logs can look alive while no batch proof progress occurs
stop_conditions: Any request to run Unity, broad tests, PR publication, raw gh, AWS, or root-main mutation
Any protected-path collision with unresolved occupied Unity work
Any attempt to treat #5107 legacy cards as native v2 readiness
